output.reason: [ev-53aef8a0056b] lists this under v3.0.0 "Enhancements" as newly added support for the RequestHeaderModifier filter. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured, or must be migrated. An added capability that operators only use if they choose to has no consequence for an environment whose operator does nothing, so "none" (informational) fits. The changelog doesn't say outright that there is no impact, which is why confidence is low.
